Notably the entire cascade is concentrated in ~856 time units of a 9600-unit window, consistent with a single propagating event rather than diffuse background activity. Tightening max_wait to 150 breaks the chain at the first hop (step_08), which bounds the mechanism's timescale: the cascade is real but depends on waits in the 150-250 range, so the conclusion is specific to the stated 600-unit tolerance.
